subject.title: Dashboard: approvals-queue widget (deliver #72545 as a dashboard builtin)

question: Should the dashboard approvals widget initially show only dashboard custom-widget approvals, or should it also surface exec/plugin approvals by widening the dashboard binding/approval allowlist?
rationale: The issue asks for an exec approvals web surface, while the linked PR avoids adding exec/plugin approval RPCs to the dashboard read path because that expands an operator-scoped approval surface.

options.title: Start With Dashboard Approvals Only
options.body: Land the safer first widget over existing dashboard widget approvals and track exec/plugin approval sources as a separate security-reviewed follow-up.

options.title: Include Exec/Plugin Approvals Now
options.body: Require the linked PR to widen the allowlist and prove the full exec/plugin approval path, accepting a larger security review before merge.

options.title: Reject Dashboard Approval Actions
options.body: Keep approvals in the existing global modal only and close the dashboard builtin direction as not planned.

recommendation.title: Start With Dashboard Approvals Only
recommendation.body: Land the safer first widget over existing dashboard widget approvals and track exec/plugin approval sources as a separate security-reviewed follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history across the approval/security and Control UI approval surfaces.
